rules.description: Ctrl+forward delete deletes next word, except in terminals
Ctrl+Delete deletes previous word (not whole line), except in kitty
Iris: Ctrl+= zooms out (Cmd+-) and Ctrl+_ zooms in (Cmd++), as in kitty; except in terminals
Ctrl(+Shift)+key also sends Cmd(+Shift)+key, except in terminals
Ctrl+Opt+Cmd+Shift+Return opens a new kitty window (global)

to.shell_command: if /usr/bin/pgrep -aqx kitty; then /Applications/kitty.app/Contents/MacOS/kitty --single-instance --directory ~; else /usr/bin/open -a kitty; fi

rules.description: Ctrl+Opt+Cmd+Shift+B opens a new Firefox window (global)

to.shell_command: if /usr/bin/pgrep -aqx firefox; then /Applications/Firefox.app/Contents/MacOS/firefox --new-window; else /usr/bin/open -a Firefox; fi
